objective: Reduce the fixed Linux latency of query.py for the sealed skin-data workload while preserving the exact registered response+quality hash. The evaluator starts every measurement in a fresh process with empty SQLite connection state and verified page-cache eviction. Only query/indexing/batching/cache strategy may change; eval.py, worker.py, and toolchain.lock.json are protected.

meta.provenance: read-only owner repository trade-up-bot at 2a37202187912bedfbe5b4d65498feef09797935; synthetic scaling of server/routes/data.ts and server/db.ts shapes; no owner records

sourceDetails.derivation: scaled deterministic synthetic tables and workload derived from owner schema/query shapes; no owner records

measurement.cacheContract: immutable read-only DB; POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED plus mincore resident-fraction <= 0.01 before every process
measurement.stateReset: before every sample the trusted parent reaps worker-uid processes and removes all worker-uid persistent state (/tmp, /var/tmp, /dev/shm trees and System V IPC objects); each worker is started in fresh IPC+NET namespaces before its privilege drop; the candidate workspace is broker-mounted read-only
measurement.q: positive reciprocal latency score emitted by the trusted evaluator; invalid, broken, malformed, crashed, or timed-out output maps to qFail
